About Get Eco Driver

Get Eco Driver is an independent automotive efficiency and sustainable mobility knowledge hub founded to eliminate guesswork from eco-driving, EV battery management, and fuel conservation.

Our Mission

Modern vehicles—whether internal combustion, hybrid electric (HEV/PHEV), or full battery electric (BEV)—operate under complex thermodynamic and aerodynamic principles. Most driving advice circulated online consists of outdated myths or unsubstantiated rules of thumb. Our mission is to publish strictly empirical, engineering-tested, and data-backed guides that help motorists maximize range, reduce operational costs, and minimize environmental impact.

Editorial Standards & Methodology

Every guide published on Get Eco Driver follows rigorous technical vetting standards:

  • Empirical Telemetry & Testing: We cross-reference manufacturer technical service bulletins (TSBs), SAE International technical papers, EPA testing procedures, and real-world OBD-II telematics.
  • Algorithmic Authorship: We provide direct declarative answers upfront without speculative or hedging language.
  • Commercial Independence: Product recommendations and efficiency gear are evaluated strictly on verified performance and engineering integrity.

Contact Our Editorial Team

For technical inquiries, editorial corrections, or research collaborations, visit our Contact Us page or reach out directly to editorial@getecodriver.com.
